caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, rounded container or box with a cream-colored base. The front face of the box features an illustration of three human figures, two men and one woman, dressed in old-fashioned clothing in green and brown hues, standing among green foliage. Around them are additional green scroll-like decorative motifs and diamond shapes with a touch of pink inside. The top of the box displays a similar illustrative and decorative style, with green foliage and a central figure or group, partially visible due to the perspective angle. The edge or border of the lid is decorated with a pink checkered or grid-like pattern and circular designs. The lower portions and corners of the box are adorned with light pink floral patterns interspersed with green leaves. The composition is symmetrical and the palette consists mainly of cream, green, pink, and brown tones.
title: Bandbox
